Name: Leelo's Orange Cow Cat
Author: LeeloMods
Description:
[center][b][size=4]Description[/size][/b][/center]


Adds a cute orange cow cat to the game. This cat is based on my brother's cat, Miles, pictured below. This cat sprite is a simple recolor of the white cat sprite. Hats are fully functional with this cat sprite!


[center][b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b][/center]


Download with a mod manager for automatic installation. For manual installation, download the .zip mod folder into the StardewValley\Mods folder, extract all from the .zip folder into the same filepath (StardewValley\Mods), and you are all set.

This cat sprite serves as a standalone option, but it is also part of mod bundle that comes with a brown tabby cat, tortoiseshell cat, and tuxedo cat. See my other mod, Leelo's Cats, to view that bundle.

You do [b]not[/b] need to start a new game. The added cat can be adopted from the start or from Marnie's shop later on.

[color=#ff00ff]Remember to endorse the mod! This helps with visibility, allowing even more Stardew players to enjoy my content[/color]


[center][size=4][b]Meet the Model[/b][/size][/center]

[center]
[img width=400,height=600]https://i.imgur.com/NgQFbVm.jpeg[/img]
Miles, the orange cow cat, is a very shy boy, often running and hiding from strangers. When he gets used to someone new, he quickly demonstrates just how sweet he is. He enjoys cuddles, playing with his dog sister Daisy, and food.[/center]



[center][b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]


Requires SMAPI and content patcher for full integration.


Please feel free to post on this mod page if you are having any issues with this mod.
